saved: Toast after one of Operations' settings was saved.
save-failed: Error when a setting could not be saved.
time-zone.title: Card title: the time zone the dashboard cuts days and weeks in.
time-zone.description: {{zone}} is the server's default time zone, an IANA name such as Europe/Madrid or UTC; not translated.
time-zone.label: Label of the time zone field; its value is an IANA name such as Europe/Madrid.
time-zone.invalid: Error under the time zone field. "Europe/Madrid" is an IANA time zone name; keep it as is.
time-zone.reset: Button: goes back to the server's time zone; {{zone}} is its IANA name.
session-gap.title: Card title: how a chat's messages are cut into sessions. "Session": one sitting of a person with a socio.
session-gap.description: "Activity" and "Value" are pages of Operations. The count is the server's default gap in minutes.
session-gap.label: Label of a number field: how many minutes without messages end a session.
session-gap.invalid: Error under the gap field: {{min}} and {{max}} are minutes.
session-gap.reset: Button: goes back to the server's gap; the count is minutes.
retention.title: Card title: how often the server's resources are sampled and how many days each kind of record is kept.
retention.description: Description on the Collection and retention card of Operations › Settings. "Pruning": deleting old records; "source agent runs": the original records of socios' turns.
retention.load-failed: Error on the Collection and retention card when its settings could not be read.
retention.fields.pageUseDays: Each retention.fields.*: the label of a number field: how many days a kind of record is kept (or, for sampleEverySeconds, how often resources are sampled).
retention.fields.pageSearchDays: Days kept: the daily counts of page searches.
retention.fields.notificationDays: Days kept: notifications sent to people.
retention.fields.deliveryDays: Days kept: the records of each notification's delivery (by email, push…).
retention.fields.noticeDays: Days kept: notices shown inside the app.
retention.fields.sampleDays: Days kept: the server's resource samples and their hourly averages (the Health page).
retention.fields.factDays: Days kept: the analytics facts derived from chats, which the dashboard's numbers are built from.
retention.fields.hourlyDays: Days kept: hourly analytics totals; they can't outlast the facts they are built from.
retention.fields.sampleEverySeconds: Not days: how many seconds pass between two resource samples.
retention.default: Under a field while the server's defaults load; "…" stands for the value.
retention.default-days: Under a field: the server's default number of days.
retention.default-seconds: Under the sampling interval field: the server's default in seconds.
retention.save: Button that saves the retention card's fields.
retention.reset: Button: goes back to the server's defaults for every field.
price-sync.title: Card title: the daily update of model prices from outside price lists.
price-sync.description: "Socio" is the product's name. OpenRouter, DeepInfra, Azure, AWS, models.dev and LiteLLM are names; keep them. {{state}} is one of price-sync.state's words: the server's default.
price-sync.state: Whether the price sync is on or off by the server's default; lowercase. The base form ("…") shows while it loads.
price-sync.switch: Label of the switch that turns the daily price sync on or off.
price-sync.reset: Button: goes back to the server's default; {{state}} is on or off (price-sync.state).
